variant.briefing:
Hey,

Wondering if you can help me. I’ve lost touch with a dedicated CFP volunteer named [TargetName] who was tracking down supplies taken by XenoThreat. Their last comm said they believed our stuff was being held at [Location]. I told them to be careful, but haven’t heard anything since.

Any chance you can head out and try to locate [TargetName]? While there, if you spot the supplies, please bring them to [Destination]. I’ll give you the same warning I gave [TargetName], that spot is a known Xeno stronghold. Better be prepared. Would hate for you to disappear too after visiting that spot. 

Be Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
